summary: Use fractal-chatgpt for MCP server identity, adapter documentation, and call telemetry.

schema.detail: No database or daemon wire schema changes.

compatibility.detail: MCP serverInfo and CLI help identify fractal-chatgpt. Call events emit only fractal_chatgpt::call; the hard allowlist temporarily accepts st_chatgpt::call too. The legacy st-chatgpt executable remains a bridged alias. Cached tool aliases and paired-socket compatibility are unchanged.

manual.detail: Before upgrading, configure mixed-version deployments with RUST_LOG=off,fractal_chatgpt::call=info,st_chatgpt::call=info. An old-target-only filter does not enable new-target events. New installations use packages.fractal-chatgpt and bin/fractal-chatgpt.

recovery.detail: The dual-target environment filter supports the previous adapter binary on rollback.
